aboutText: HR Home Improvement and Cabinet Solutions has been crafting custom cabinetry throughout Mickleham and Melbourne's northern suburbs. From complete kitchen renovations to bathroom vanities, laundry cupboards, and entertainment units, we deliver tailored storage solutions for every home. Our experienced team works with homeowners, builders, and property managers across Mickleham, Wallan, and surrounding communities.
servicesText: We design and build custom cabinetry to suit your lifestyle and space. Every piece is made with precision using quality materials and finished to the highest standard.

services.title: Custom Kitchen Cabinetry
services.desc: Fully custom kitchen cabinets designed around your workflow, with soft-close drawers, pull-out storage, and your choice of materials and finishes.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities & Linen Cupboards
services.desc: Space-efficient bathroom vanities and built-in linen cupboards designed and installed to maximise storage in wet areas.

services.title: Built-In Wardrobes
services.desc: Custom built-in wardrobes with adjustable shelving, hanging space, and integrated lighting for bedrooms of any size.

services.title: Laundry Cabinetry
services.desc: Functional laundry cabinetry featuring benchtop space, under-sink storage, and drying cupboard solutions for busy Mickleham families.

services.title: Entertainment Units & Shelving
services.desc: Custom entertainment units and floating shelves built to fit your living room, complete with cable management and display areas.

services.title: Home Office Cabinetry
services.desc: Built-in desks, bookshelves, and storage wall units tailored to create a productive home office in Mickleham homes.
